texts.zh:
我们在[from.GetName]搜寻珍宝藏库的过程中，[fromfromfrom.Leader.GetName][fromfromfrom.Leader.GetWasWere]遭到了一支海盗舰队的伏击！

这些法外狂徒不知怎么发现了我们的进展，打算把这些宝物据为己有。如果我们想要拿到这些宝藏，就必须在他们抢到之前打败他们的舰队。
texts.en:
As we were searching for the Treasure Trove on [from.GetName], [fromfromfrom.Leader.GetName] [fromfromfrom.Leader.GetWasWere] ambushed by a pirate fleet!

These outlaws have somehow trailed our progress and seek to take the treasure for themselves. If we are to collect this bounty, we must defeat their fleet before they secure the valuables.

texts.zh:
投机取巧的海盗抢走了[event_target:treasure_trove_planet.GetName]的珍宝藏库。

现在已经没剩什么值得一提的东西了。
texts.en:
The opportunistic pirates have plundered the Treasure Trove on [event_target:treasure_trove_planet.GetName].

There is nothing of value left for us to take.

texts.zh: 有一支海盗舰队在追寻着[this.GetName]的珍宝藏库！
texts.en: A pirate fleet is after the Treasure Trove on [this.GetName]!
